answer: Sybil farms choke when every key must prove it read unique prior work. At open, each key gets three quiz items drawn from sealed answers outside its own lineage. Score under two of three zeros that epoch pay. A thousand-key farm faces three thousand distinct quizzes in one window, so shared workers bottleneck. Publish pass counts each close. An oasis of honest keys grows while a glacier of clones melts across the tundra of wasted compute.
